title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
lyrics: Twin-kle twin-kle lit-tle star, how I won-der what you are. Up a-bove the world so high, like a dia-mond in the sky. Twin-kle twin-kle lit-tle star, how I won-der what you are.
sing: Twin-kle twin-kle lit-tle star, hao ai wan-der wat yu ar. Ap a-bav tha werld so hai, laik a dai-mand in tha skai. Twin-kle twin-kle lit-tle star, hao ai wan-der wat yu ar.
notes: C4 C4 G4 G4 A4 A4 G4:2 F4 F4 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2 G4 G4 F4 F4 E4 E4 D4:2 G4 G4 F4 F4 E4 E4 D4:2 C4 C4 G4 G4 A4 A4 G4:2 F4 F4 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2

title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat
lyrics: Row, row, row your boat, gent-ly down the stream. Mer-ri-ly, mer-ri-ly, mer-ri-ly, mer-ri-ly, life is but a dream.
sing: Roh, roh, roh yor bot, jent-lee daon tha streem. Mer-ri-lee, mer-ri-lee, mer-ri-lee, mer-ri-lee, laif iz bat a dreem.

title: Hot Cross Buns
lyrics: Hot cross buns, hot cross buns, one a pen-ny, two a pen-ny, hot cross buns.
sing: Hot cros bans, hot cros bans, wan a pen-ee, tu a pen-ee, hot cros bans.

title: Mary Had a Little Lamb
lyrics: Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb, lit-tle lamb, lit-tle lamb. Ma-ry had a lit-tle lamb, its fleece was white as snow.
sing: Ma-ree had a lit-tle lam, lit-tle lam, lit-tle lam. Ma-ree had a lit-tle lam, its fleez waz wait az sno.
notes: E4 D4 C4 D4 E4 E4 E4:2 D4 D4 D4:2 E4 G4 G4:2 E4 D4 C4 D4 E4 E4 E4 E4 D4 D4 E4 D4 C4:3

title: Old MacDonald (first lines)
lyrics: Old Mac-Don-ald had a farm, E-I-E-I-O.
sing: Ohld Mak Dohn ald had a farm, ee ai ee ai oh.
notes: C4 C4 C4 G4 A4 A4 G4:2 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2

title: Frère Jacques (French)
lyrics: Frè-re Jac-ques, Frè-re Jac-ques, dor-mez-vous? Dor-mez-vous? Son-nez les ma-ti-nes, son-nez les ma-ti-nes, Din din don. Din din don.
sing: Fre-re Jak-ke, Fre-re Jak-ke, dor-me vu? Dor-me vu? Son-ne le ma-ti-ne, son-ne le ma-ti-ne, Din din don. Din din don.
